name: documentary_binding
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
p=Path.cwd()
for name in ['zigzag','zigzag-companion']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/f'inputs/{name}.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True)
 print(name,'exit',r.returncode,'exact supplied text equality',r.stdout==(p/f'inputs/{name}.txt').read_bytes(),'pdf sha256',hashlib.sha256((p/f'inputs/{name}.pdf').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('Budget', (p/'search-budget.json').read_text())
print('Frozen map', (p/'frozen-inputs.json').read_text())
